routes.name: Visa-Free Entry
routes.summary: Citizens of many countries enter without a visa, with stays like 30 or 90 days depending on country. Some must now get an ETA online before travel. Check the country table on the portal.

other: Official table lists 30 days for countries like Malawi, Zambia and Zimbabwe, 90 days for Botswana, Kenya, Rwanda and Tanzania. Confirm your own passport on the portal.

routes.name: Electronic Travel Authorization (eTA)
routes.summary: Some visa-exempt travelers must register online and get an eTA before travel. Apply at least 48 hours before departure.

other: Fees not listed on the official page.

stay.note: Stay as shown on the approval, often 30 days.

routes.name: eVisa Tourist
routes.summary: Tourist eVisa for up to 90 days. Passport must be valid 6 months. Standard processing is about 5 business days.

other: Fees not listed on the official page.

routes.name: eVisa Business
routes.summary: Business eVisa for research, meetings or conferences, up to 90 days.

other: Fees not listed on the official page.

routes.name: eVisa Investment Activity
routes.summary: For people investing in a project worth US$500 thousand or more.

other: Investment threshold of USD 500,000 from the portal. Fees not listed.

routes.name: eVisa Sports and Culture
routes.summary: For accredited sports or cultural events, training or demonstrations.

other: Fees not listed on the official page.

routes.name: eVisa Crew
routes.summary: For airline or cruise ship crew traveling for business.

other: Fees not listed on the official page.

routes.name: eVisa Humanitarian Assistance
routes.summary: For non-profit humanitarian work during declared emergencies, when invited by a government or organization.

other: Fees not listed on the official page.

routes.name: Work Visa (Oil and Gas)
routes.summary: Work eVisa for activities with registered oil and gas companies. Other work routes were not readable.

other: Fees not listed on the official page.

routes.name: Business Visa (Oil and Gas)
routes.summary: Business eVisa for activities with registered oil and gas companies.

other: Fees not listed on the official page.
